scenes.vo: Energy is changing. [[slnc 280]] And the opportunity ahead is much bigger than solar.

The journey can evolve from a solar marketplace... [[slnc 280]] to an ecosystem. [[slnc 240]] From an ecosystem... [[slnc 240]] to an energy platform. [[slnc 280]] Then to energy intelligence. [[slnc 280]] And ultimately — national clean-energy infrastructure.
Imagine every participating energy asset having its own digital identity. [[slnc 280]] An OorjaMan Energy Passport — transferable with the property.
Now imagine energy performance becoming measurable. [[slnc 280]] An OorjaMan Energy Score — for homes, hotels, hospitals, industry.
The proposition can move beyond selling solar. [[slnc 280]] Toward something much bigger. [[slnc 280]] Energy independence.
Trust can become the difference. [[slnc 280]] OorjaMan Verified vendors. [[slnc 240]] And a Vendor Rating that can make quality visible.
Finance can sit inside the journey. [[slnc 240]] Loans. EMI. Lease. Pay-as-you-save. [[slnc 280]] Or solar as a service — clean electricity by the month.
Artificial intelligence can turn a simple electricity bill into an intelligent energy plan.
When performance drops, intelligence can find the gap. [[slnc 260]] And every plant can carry an Energy Health Score — green, yellow or red.

Behind the platform is care. [[slnc 200]] AMC, cleaning, inspection, emergency service. [[slnc 220]] Technicians who can take the next job. [[slnc 200]] And an academy that can certify the people who keep it running.
And the ecosystem can extend far beyond solar — generation, storage, mobility, efficiency, finance and care.
The same operating system can serve apartments. [[slnc 280]] And millions of MSMEs — from the electricity bill to the saving.
Energy data can become intelligence for businesses. [[slnc 220]] A carbon wallet of green points. [[slnc 220]] And, over time, a green-property layer for India.
At scale, this network could become something even bigger. [[slnc 280]] An energy intelligence layer for India.

OorjaMan doesn't need to manufacture every component. [[slnc 280]] The opportunity is to become the layer that connects everyone. [[slnc 280]] And, eventually, the APIs other institutions can build on.
The ultimate opportunity is to own the customer journey. [[slnc 280]] Every step can create value. [[slnc 280]] And every step can generate intelligence.
As the platform grows, new layers of recurring value can emerge — without introducing all of them at once.
The future of energy will not be built by one company. [[slnc 280]] It will be built by an ecosystem. [[slnc 280]] And OorjaMan can be the layer that connects it.
